class StackUnderflowError < StandardError; end

class Stack
  private

  def initialize
    @elements = []
  end

  public

  def push(element)
    @elements << element
  end

  def pop
    raise StackUnderflowError if empty?
    @elements.pop
  end

  def peek
    raise StackUnderflowError if empty?
    @elements.last
  end

  def empty?
    @elements.empty?
  end
end
